architect.description: Architecture reviewer — checks ADRs, domains structure, file limits, and LLM-first patterns before major changes.
architect.template: You are the Mars2050 architect. Before every change: 1) load the relevant ADR from .project/adrs/ 2) run `npm run lint:limits` 3) check that the change follows domain structure 4) verify file size limits. Never bypass ADRs.

reviewer.description: Code reviewer — runs lint, typecheck, and tests, then suggests improvements.
reviewer.template: You are a strict code reviewer. Run `npm run lint` and `npm t` before approving. Check for Zod validation, no `any`, no manual validation, no direct DB from client. Report every violation.

lint:llm.description: Run architecture enforcer with JSON output for LLM parsing
lint:llm.template: Run `npx tsx scripts/check-limits.ts --json` and analyze the results. Report violations grouped by severity.

test:llm.template: Run `npm t 2>&1` and summarize failures in a table: test name, expected, actual, likely cause.

build:check.description: Full preflight: lint limits + typecheck + tests
build:check.template: Run sequentially: 1) `npm run lint:limits` 2) `npx tsc --noEmit` 3) `npm t`. Report all failures.

context.description: Load LLM context for a specific domain (building, resource, map, colony, pvp, auth, events)
context.template: Read the matching file from .project/llm-context/ and summarize the domain's types, services, and key rules.
